name: Paper2Web_bench
description: A benchmark that evaluates the ability to map academic papers to their corresponding web resources (e.g., official webpage, code repository, or supplemental material) and/or to retrieve relevant web pages given paper metadata or text. It measures retrieval and URL/match prediction performance for models that link paper content to web locations. The dataset is intended to test web-aware retrieval and grounding capabilities of NLP systems.
reputation: A small community dataset on Hugging Face with limited but growing use for paper-to-web retrieval experiments.
